problem_statement: Singapore SMEs lack affordable robotics automation for warehouse picking, forcing them to rely on manual labor that is increasingly hard to hire.
solution: Acme Robotics builds a modular picking-arm system that integrates with existing warehouse racking with under a week of installation time.
market_opportunity: The Southeast Asian warehouse automation market is projected to grow significantly as e-commerce fulfilment volumes rise and labor costs increase.
founder_background: Alice Tan spent 6 years as a robotics lead at a logistics automation firm; Bob Lee previously ran commercial operations at a warehousing SaaS startup.
use_of_funds: Funds will cover 2 additional engineering hires, tooling for a second prototype revision, and a 6-month pilot with two warehouse operators.
